Use-OlderObjects.name: Use 2.1 pixels
Use-OlderObjects.description:
Will use the old 2.1 pixel object instead of the newer one.
This will <cr>not</c> work with the basic optimisation.

Colour-channel.name: Colour channel
Colour-channel.description:
The colour channel that the pixels are put on.
I do <cr>not</c> recommend changing this.

Optimise-Type.name: Optimisation
Optimise-Type.description:
Different methods of optimising the art
Basic: Optimises the art using 4 different objects of different sizes.
Scale: Uses scaling to optimise the pixel art. This is still in development and will <cr>not</c> work for most images. Only works if <cr>optimise art</c> is unchecked.

Background-Optimisation.name: Optimise background
Background-Optimisation.description: Whether to optimise the background of the image using the most common colour as the background. Recommended when using jpg however keep it off if your using transparent images.

Tolerance.name: Tolerance
Tolerance.description: how similar the colours need to be for a group to be replaced with 1 object.

Size-limit.name: Size limit
Size-limit.description: Number of pixels able to be imported.

Disable-limit.name: Remove size limit
Disable-limit.description:
Will remove the default size limit for images that can be imported.
Can cause <cr>crashes</c> if the image is too big so is not recommended.
